'''2000 Indiana State Championship Matthew Wright x-wing deck from indiana states''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Matthew Wright]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 2–1 at [[2000 Indiana State Championship]]. The post's title calls it the 'x-wing deck from indiana states'; the description says it 'went 2-1 losing only to the winner of states' (posted 24 April 2000).<ref name="dt-5925">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5925 x-wing deck from indiana states], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 24 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5925/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5925/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018180444/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5925/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''x-wing deck from indiana states'''
* '''Author:''' Matthew "Teknologik" Wright
* '''Published:''' April 24, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' This deck went 2-1 losing only to the winner of states. It several good people too.

=== Strategy ===

Regular  x-wing beatdown.  Use spies and POAS to stop the Drains. If they come to space, usually they will get killed, unless they deploy all their starships to the same location but then you can outdrain them.

vs. Space. Should do well against it.  I playtested this deck and it got beat by it.

vs. Huntdown. Get spies to their sites and cancel visage.  Use x-wings for beatdown.

vs. Raltiir. This might be trouble but you should be able to grab alter and cancel all of the drains.  Outdrain and rebel barrier their starships.  Use the cannons to kill their bounty hunters.

vs.  Ground Same as the raltiir.
